subtasks.title: Scout hit disposition — Sanctum endpoint (kit-scoped), scan_id in driver payloads, MapShell disposition control with optimistic removal
subtasks.approach: Full-stack, single cohesive feature (driver Scout only). BACKEND: (1) New controller App\Http\Controllers\Api\ClarityScoutScanDispositionController (single __invoke), reusing ScanDispositionRequest for validation; authorize the scan to the DRIVER'S OWN KIT only via Scan::query()->where('id',$request->input('scan_id'))->where('kit_id',$request->user()->kit_id)->firstOrFail() (404 on another kit's scan — do NOT use forOrg()); then $scan->updateDisposition(disposition,user,reason) (which already writes Postgres + dispatches SyncDispositionToClickhouse) and Analytics::track('disposition-saved',...) mirroring DispositionController; return 200 on success, 500 on exception (mirror the existing controller's try/catch + Log::error). (2) Register Route::post('scan/disposition', ClarityScoutScanDispositionController::class)->middleware('throttle:30,1') INSIDE the existing scout auth:sanctum + ClarityScoutMiddleware group in routes/api.php (full path /api/scout/scan/disposition). (3) Add 'scan_id' => $hit->scan_id to the driver map hits() payload (ClarityScoutMapController) and add 'scan_id' => $hit->scan_id alongside the existing 'id' in the driver recentHits() payload (ClarityScoutDashboardController). scan_id is already a distinct CH column selected by the default * projection — verify $hit->scan_id resolves; no CH query change. FRONTEND (no JS test runner; manual/agent QA): (4) MapShell.vue — add a disposition <select> + Invalid-Scan reason-capture UI inside the existing BottomSheet hit-details content, mirroring resources/views/components/scans/disposition-popup.blade.php (reason grid shown only for the literal 'Invalid Scan'); options mirror DispositionEnum's standard formOptions set (use the cleanest existing way to reach the Scout frontend; a static options list matching DispositionEnum is acceptable if no enum-to-JS bridge exists). (5) map.js — add an action (e.g. updateSelectedHitDisposition) that POSTs {scan_id, disposition, reason} to /scout/scan/disposition via lib/fetch.js (Bearer), and on HTTP 200 OPTIMISTICALLY removes the hit from selectedHits/markers + clears selection (mirror the optimistic DOM removal in resources/js/app.js:111-113), reconciling on the next poll.
subtasks.intended_diffs: See approach. New controller ~40 lines modeled on DispositionController but kit-scoped. routes/api.php: one route line in the scout group. Two 1-line payload additions (scan_id). MapShell.vue: a select + conditional reason UI + submit handler. map.js: one store action with optimistic removal. Tests: a new endpoint test (200 own-kit / 404 other-kit / validation / Queue::fake dispatch / reason capture) modeled on DispositionControllerTest; scan_id assertions added to the two existing payload tests.
subtasks.security_note: Kit-scoped tenancy is the security-critical invariant: a driver must NOT be able to disposition a scan outside their assigned kit_id. Enforce with where('kit_id',$user->kit_id)->firstOrFail(); pin with a cross-kit 404 test. Phase 5 escalates to 3 review lanes (auth/permission territory).

perf_gate.reason: No CH read query is added or changed; scan_id is an existing column added to an existing projection. No deferred-perf CH-at-scale design.

sizing: One cohesive full-stack feature: 5 code files (1 new controller, 1 route line, 2 one-line payload adds, 2 frontend files) + 3 test files across 3 layers. Just over the 6-file heuristic counting tests, but a single tightly-coupled feature (endpoint<->payload<->UI contract), not multiple distinct concerns — no ticket split recommended; Dalton opted into the scope at the gate.
